name: Macotera (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a red band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Macotera (a tree on yellow and a bottle on white).
history: The arms of Macotera were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 7 September 1962; the municipal flag was approved on 4 July 1997 and is square, of proportion 1:1, tierced per bend sinister of white, red and white, charged at the centre with the arms.
